annotations.title: Preview a Meta ad exactly as it will appear

description: Render a REAL preview of a Meta ad, per placement — Meta returns a link that shows exactly what a person scrolling Facebook or Instagram would see. Pass adAccountId + adId (from list_meta_ads), or creativeId. Optional placements (comma-separated): facebook_feed, facebook_feed_desktop, facebook_story, facebook_reels, facebook_profile_feed, facebook_marketplace, facebook_right_column, facebook_video_feed, instagram_feed, instagram_story, instagram_reels, instagram_explore, instagram_profile_feed, messenger_inbox, messenger_story, audience_network — default facebook_feed + instagram_feed + instagram_story + instagram_reels. Short words are read too and the reply says how: feed means facebook_feed, story/stories means facebook_story, reels means facebook_reels, instagram/ig means instagram_feed, ig_story, ig_reels. Free, read-only, spends nothing. THE LINKS EXPIRE AFTER 24 HOURS — always say so when handing them to a user. Use it straight after create_meta_ad, and whenever someone wants to approve an ad before it runs. BEFORE ANY AD EXISTS: leave adId and creativeId out and pass imageHash (from upload_meta_asset) or imageUrl, with message, link and optionally headline, description, cta and pageId; Meta renders that creative per placement and nothing is created.

creativeId.description: preview a creative directly instead of an ad

cta.description: before any ad exists: the button, e.g. SHOP_NOW (default LEARN_MORE)

description.description: before any ad exists: the description line

headline.description: before any ad exists: the headline

imageHash.description: before any ad exists: an image hash from upload_meta_asset

imageUrl.description: before any ad exists: a public https image

link.description: before any ad exists: the destination link

message.description: before any ad exists: the primary text

pageId.description: before any ad exists: the Page the ad runs from, when the brand has several
